### Feature flow

Where the features of the input file ended in this data version (`r method_label[MAT]`): from their
type (left) to their status after the processing (right). Hover over a band for the number of
features; the same per feature is in the tab *Feature history*.

```{r}
# Type -> status of the feature history (projlib/history.R, as in the app)
fh <- tr[["feature history"]][[MAT]]
history$plotly_feature_flow(fh)
```

### Fallbacks and removals

What the processing did differently from the usual way because the data did not allow it
(**fallback**), and what it left out (**removed**), counted per step. The full list, one row per
feature, sample or batch, is below; the same is exported in the processing history
(`….history.xlsx`).

```{r}
ev <- tr[["events"]]
ev <- ev[is.na(ev$mat_id) | ev$mat_id == MAT, ]
if (nrow(ev) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output("Nothing was removed and no fallback was needed.\n")
} else {
  ev |>
    group_by(Step = step, Kind = kind, Event = event, `Applies to` = scope) |>
    summarise(Count = n(), Examples = paste(head(unique(name), 5), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(Examples = ifelse(Count > 5, paste0(Examples, ", …"), Examples)) |>
    knitr::kable()
}
```

```{r}
if (nrow(ev) > 0) {
  ev |>
    transmute(Step = step, Kind = factor(kind), `Applies to` = factor(scope), Name = name,
              Batch = batch_id, Event = factor(event), Detail = detail) |>
    dt() |>
    DT::formatStyle("Kind", backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(c("removed", "fallback"), c(FAILED_BG, KEPT_BG)))
}
```

### Feature history

One row per feature of the input file, also those removed on the way: what each step did with it,
in the order of the processing (empty: the step does not concern the feature, or it was removed
before). Filter the columns to find a feature or a status.

```{r}
fh |>
  mutate(across(c(Type, Status), factor)) |>
  dt() |>
  DT::formatStyle("Status", backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
    c("Removed (failed IS)", "Removed (blank filter)", "Removed (QC RSD% filter)", "Not quantified"),
    rep(FAILED_BG, 4)))
```

### Sample history

One row per sample of the input file: what each step did with it.

```{r}
tr[["sample history"]] |>
  mutate(across(c(`Sample type`, Status, Batch), factor)) |>
  dt() |>
  DT::formatStyle("Status", backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual("Removed (outlier)", FAILED_BG))
```
